findings: UpdateWidget mutation was parent-scoped but its response SELECT was child-id-only, allowing a wrong-dashboard request to return a foreign child.
The response SELECT now includes dashboard_id; a focused actual DuckDB test covers refusal and unchanged owner state when a Go toolchain is available.
tests: Portable Go 1.27.1 isolated actual-source run: go test ./storage -run TestUpdateWidgetRejectsWidgetFromAnotherDashboard -count=1; 1/1 passed in 5.930s.
limitations: Temporary isolated module uses a faithful in-memory database/sql adapter and a local UUID stub to avoid the incompatible DuckDB native bindings.
The real application DuckDB package was not executed; no API or concurrency claim.
